sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The graph still does not faithfully encode the contextual relationships required by the COMPLEX_READINESS contract. It places serviceLife, extremeLoad, propellerIceInteractionLoad, and thrusterBodyIceInteractionLoad independently on the ship, while only normalOperationalConditions, expected load, and local-strength capacity are placed on the design condition; therefore it does not establish that the azimuthing thruster-body load is the expected service-life load under normal operational conditions or that the capacity/localIcePressure DIRECT_CHECK applies when the thruster body is designed for extreme loads. Locate and add the canonical relationship/path terms needed to link these facts to the appropriate design condition and thruster-body load, preserving the supplied required owners rather than relocating properties.
